claims.text: RRS-2 (checksums quarterly or more often): no NCEI, NOAA or NESDIS document found states a periodic fixity or checksum check of the archive or how often it runs. GHCN-Daily's 2021 maturity review (DSMR-00227) scores Data Integrity 2 of 5: a checksum is stored per file and given on request; NCEI validates provider checksums at ingest; WDS-Paleo (an NCEI unit) checks MD5 only when a file is pulled and compares file sizes, not checksums, monthly. NAO 212-15 sets no checksum rule. Not supported.

evidence.passage: Level 2 | Data ingest integrity verifiable - a checksum is stored in the archive catalog for each data | file in the archive. | Data Integrity | Comments: | This checksum can be provided upon request, however, neither this nor other checksums are | put online with the data.
"NCEI software will validate the data files against their checksums in order to maintain data integrity." … "NCEI currently recommends the use of the SHA-2 family of cryptographic hash functions."

The repository loads a md5 checksum associated with the data file into the Oracle digital catalog. Any time a file is pulled | either from primary or offsite, the file's checksum is checked against the catalog. Every month the repository runs scripts | that compare file sizes between the primary and offsite to detect either mismatches or if one of the copies is missing. New | ingest software is being phased in at the repository to further automate comparisons with more frequency.

claims.text: RRS-5 (survived a major disruption without data loss): after Hurricane Helene (27 Sep 2024) NCEI said its holdings were safe and restored ingest with Boulder, Mississippi and Maryland staff and facilities; by 11 Dec 2024 ingest was fully restored and 92% of the ingest backlog recovered. But NCEI also warned that some not-yet-ingested observations 'might eventually be unrecoverable', and an undated page says a few datasets are still being recovered. The archive survived; incoming data may not all have. No statement on GHCN-Daily itself. Partly supported.

evidence.passage: NCEI headquarters in Asheville, NC, was severely impacted by Hurricane Helene on September 27, 2024. The | building lost power, water, and communications, disrupting data feeds and essential products. All personnel | were safe, and efforts to secure NCEI's data holdings were successful. By December 11, operational ingest of | archival data streams was fully restored, and 92% of the ingest backlog was recovered. Data loss was mitigated | with support from NCEI's Boulder, CO location. NCEI archives over 229 terabytes of data monthly

NCEI’s data holdings — including its paper and film records — are also safe. … NCEI is leveraging facilities and staff in Colorado, Mississippi and Maryland to bring some systems and data ingest capabilities back into operation.
